notes.title: Heads up: Brainmelter Deluxe will soon be free!
notes.notes:
Hey there, in an effort to find more players for some of my older games, I've decided to make Brainmelter Deluxe free! As per Valve policy, I'm providing one month's notice before the making the change. You can expect the change near the end of May.

While I have no immediate plans to update the game (apart from bug fixes as and improvements), I should mention that I have a number of handcrafted levels lying around that I may consider releasing down the road, if there's enough demand.

P.S. The [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CosmocatGames.BrainmelterDeluxe&hl=en_CA]Android version[/url] is already free as of this morning!

notes.title: Introducing: Super Rocket Ride!
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce my latest game, Super Rocket Ride!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020503/e21ef2a2663609cb12948c92a7f49206d6e21789.png[/img]

It can best be described as a cross between old school lander games and classic platformers of the SNES era: a simple control scheme, lush pixel art, and unforgiving levels fraught with obstacles and hazards.

Super Rocket Ride is being developed in collaboration with Unruly Games.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UYiYXqGusUs
[b]Features[/b]
🚀 24 hand-crafted levels (with more on the way)
🚀 Analog controls
🚀 Over-the-top physics-based deaths
🚀 Contemporary atmospheric soundtrack featuring music from Snug, JFS and Ogotu

The game will be hitting Steam in the next few months. If you're interested in checking it out ahead of that, we're running [url=https://cosmocat.itch.io/super-rocket-ride]early access on Itch[/url] for the next little while.

We're also offering [url=https://dodistribute.com/access/1FfsnuogYx/]advance copies[/url] for streamers, reviewers, and curators. All we ask is that you reflect the early access status in your coverage, and update it when the game releases in full.

Last but not least, don't forget to join the official [url=http://cosmocatgames.com/discord/]Cosmocat Discord[/url] to stay up to date about my games and chat with other players about the things that matter in life (mostly: games, beer, cats and music).

notes.title: Build 23
notes.notes:
Build 23 is now live and includes the following:

[h1]Major visual overhaul![/h1]
[list]
[*]all levels now have proper floor tile details
[*]main and transition levels have some extra background details
[*]improve boss particles, align lighting colour with animation state
[*]add some background animation (spinning fan blades)
[*]spinning objects now have a little "anchor" point rather than just fading to nothing
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33949043/5815b44b29d4d76853737e98858143fbb14e03da.gif[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]fix for some particles escaping (or getting stuck in) level geometry (blood, boss impact, steam)
[*]minor changes to main level generation, plus some special surprises in the transition level progression (you'll see...)
[*]simple lefty support (A/D for movement, however, W/S not implemented for looking up/down yet)
[/list]
